verdict.rationale: Semgrep's docs mention that rules can be written to 'scan configuration files' as one use case (docs-21/35), which implies some IaC coverage, but the evidence pack never explicitly names Terraform, Kubernetes, Dockerfile, or IaC misconfiguration scanning as a supported capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Terraform/Kubernetes/Dockerfile rule packs, dedicated IaC scanning mode or product tier, and any community/hands-on confirmation of IaC misconfiguration detection.
